invariants: Every workpackages/active/<id>.json filename stem equals its workpackage_id and references an id present in workpackages/STATE.json.
Every active pointer has a positive integer generation, non-empty claim_id and worker_id, and a claim object with matching workpackage_id, generation and claim_id.
Pointer schema spelling is compatibility metadata only; all admitted v1 spellings share the same required core identity fields.
An ACTIVE pointer is inconsistent with STATE status ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE or NOT_STARTED; active mutation authority requires a non-terminal machine state.
A terminal pointer requires exactly one matching reconciliation under workpackages/reconciliations/<id>/ whose workpackage_id, generation, claim_id and terminal_state match the pointer.
A STATE entry marked ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE requires a non-empty evidence list with at least one repository-local evidence path that exists.

Terminal ACCEPTED is a scoped claim-generation result and does not force the broader STATE entry to ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE; broader workpackage status may remain IN_PROGRESS when the reconciliation explicitly records a narrower accepted scope.
Historical duplicate claims are evidence only; the single file workpackages/active/<id>.json remains the mechanical mutation-authority pointer.
This contract cannot mint provider, VPS, GRID10, effect, training or whole-system runtime credit.
acceptance_boundary: A PASS proves only repository-local consistency of the machine-readable workpackage state/claim/generation/reconciliation surfaces at one exact source identity.
